component.name: Perigee
component.summary: Remote desktop and game streaming client based on Moonlight Qt

description.p: Perigee is a Linux remote desktop and game streaming client based on Moonlight Qt. Connect to a compatible Sunshine or Apollo host to stream your desktop and games.
Hardware video decoding, audio, keyboard, mouse and gamepad support are inherited from Moonlight Qt. Available codecs and acceleration depend on your hardware and drivers.
Perigee uses independent settings and client credentials. Its temporary icon is the upstream Moonlight Qt icon; original artwork is planned.
